services.name: Rental Program
services.desc: DP’s Rental Program serves self-producing artists, dance and theater companies, non-profit service organizations, and educational institutions needing affordable space to showcase work. This program is best suited for folks who want a full service location. Amenities: Because of the amenities, professional services, and accessibility DP offers, many companies return annually. Past participants in SRP include New Georges, Siti Theater Conservatory, Pen Festival, Lama Theatre Company, Inclined Dance, Sarah Lawrence College, The Field, NYC Dance Parade, White Wave Dance Festival, Visions Contemporary Ballet, Russian Children’s Studio, Raghavan Indian Classical Dance, among dozens of others.
